At ₹80,000 aim for a laptop with these and you'll be well covered for programming:

RAM: 16 GB minimum. It matters more than anything else if you run Docker, an emulator or several projects at once.
Storage: 512 GB SSD. Make sure the RAM or SSD can be upgraded later.
Processor: a recent Ryzen 5 or 7, an Intel Core i5 or Ultra 5 (H or P series), or an Apple M-series chip if a MacBook fits your budget.
Screen: a bright 14 to 15 inch display with a 16:10 shape shows more lines of code. Full HD or better.
Keyboard and battery: a comfortable keyboard and 8+ hours of battery if you work away from a plug.

Skip a dedicated graphics card unless you do machine learning or games. It adds cost and weight and cuts battery life.

What will you mostly code: web or apps, data and ML, or games?
